verses.text: What happiness for those whose guilt has been forgiven! What joys when sins are covered over! What relief for those who have confessed their sins and God has cleared their record.
There was a time when I wouldn’t admit what a sinner I was. But my dishonesty made me miserable and filled my days with frustration.

footnotes.text: when I wouldn’t admit what a sinner I was, literally, “when I kept silence.”

verses.text: All day and all night your hand was heavy on me. My strength evaporated like water on a sunny day
until I finally admitted all my sins to you and stopped trying to hide them. I said to myself, “I will confess them to the Lord.” And you forgave me! All my guilt is gone.
Now I say that each believer should confess his sins to God when he is aware of them, while there is time to be forgiven. Judgment will not touch him if he does.

footnotes.text: Judgment will not touch him, literally, “When the great waters overflow they shall not reach him.”

verses.text: You are my hiding place from every storm of life; you even keep me from getting into trouble! You surround me with songs of victory.
I will instruct you (says the Lord) and guide you along the best pathway for your life; I will advise you and watch your progress.
Don’t be like a senseless horse or mule that has to have a bit in its mouth to keep it in line!
Many sorrows come to the wicked, but abiding love surrounds those who trust in the Lord.
So rejoice in him, all those who are his, and shout for joy, all those who try to obey him.*

footnotes.text: all those who are his, literally, “you righteous.” all those who try to obey him, literally, “all who are upright in heart.”
